question: Which of the following is a major risk associated with fuel spillage?
solution:
The correct answer is __Fire hazards and environmental contamination__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fuel spillage__ is a major hazard in industrial and environmental contexts.
 
• It poses a significant fire hazard due to the flammable nature of most fuels.
 
• Spillage can lead to environmental contamination, harming ecosystems and water sources.
 
• Proper handling, storage, and containment measures are essential to mitigate these risks.
 
• Regulations and safety protocols are in place in many industries to prevent fuel spillage incidents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fire Hazards:**

 
 
• Fuel spillage increases the risk of fire, especially in areas with ignition sources.
 
• Immediate cleanup and proper disposal are required to minimize fire risks.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Contamination:**
 
 
• Spilled fuel can seep into the soil, contaminating groundwater and affecting plant and animal life.
 
• It can spread to water bodies, leading to oil slicks and harming aquatic ecosystems.
